```yaml
name: Maintenance - Agentic Workflow Category Check

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # daily

jobs:
  check-category:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check agentic workflow categories
        run: |
          echo "Searching for create-discussion steps with incorrect category..."
          find .github/workflows -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) | while read -r wf; do
            if grep -q 'create-discussion' "$wf"; then
              cat_line=$(grep -n 'category:' "$wf" | head -n 1)
              if [[ -n "$cat_line" ]]; then
                cat_value=$(echo "$cat_line" | awk -F': ' '{print $2}' | tr -d '"')
                if [[ "$cat_value" != "agentic-workflows" ]]; then
                  echo "❌ $wf has category '$cat_value' instead of 'agentic-workflows'"
                  exit 1
                fi
              else
                echo "❌ $wf does not specify a category"
                exit 1
              fi
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All agentic workflow discussions have correct category."
```
